Newborns feel pain MORE acutely than adults — their inhibitory pathways aren't developed yet. #babyfacts #medicalhistory #mythbusted #newborn #science

Your baby is literally speaking a language 👶

Your baby is literally speaking a language 👶

Researchers identified 3 distinct cry types:
• Hunger — rhythmic, low-pitched
• Pain — sudden, high-pitched burst
• Tiredness — whiny, nasal

Most parents learn to tell them apart in just 2 weeks.

You're not guessing. You're learning.

#babyfacts #newborn #parenting #babycrying #newbornlife

Deaf babies babble with their hands 🤟 By 6 months, hearing babies babble sounds specific to their native language. Deaf babies raised with sign language babble the same way — with hand shapes. Language is hardwired. Mouth vs hands doesn't matter. #babyfacts #babylanguage #signlanguage #development #amazingfacts
Your baby doubles their weight in 5 months. If you grew that fast youd weigh 300+ lbs #BabyFacts

Late walkers aren't behind — the range is massive 👣 Average walking age: 12 months. Normal range: 9-15 months. Einstein reportedly didn't walk until 15 months. Stop comparing. The range exists because every brain develops differently. #babyfacts #babywalking #developmentmilestones #parenting #newparent

Newborns aren't 'nearly blind' — they're perfectly calibrated 👁️

They see best at 8-12 inches.

That's EXACTLY the distance from a nursing mother's breast to her face.

Evolution didn't leave this to chance.

#babyfacts #newborn #babyeyes #evolution #parentingfacts
